==Description==
'''Canyon''' was a [[Maps|map]] created by nixeerking, located in the desert.

==Design & Path==
'''Canyon''' took place in a gorge in the middle of an expansive desert with steep cliffs running down the left, middle and right side of the map. There was also a waterfall that spills water into a deep stream. Being in the middle of a desert, there was very little in the way of human habitation with the only signs being the wooden bridges which spanned the steam and wooden fences dotted around the map. However, broken pillars could also be seen around the map.

The beige path began and ended at two man-made cave entrances in the sand mountains and took two distinctive long straights. In the middle of the map, the path cut across the overhang. Additionally, the path went across two wooden bridges that spanned the stream.

==Strategy==
*While the corners are where you can maximize the range of ground towers, this gives the opportunity for [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]]s, [[Necromancer 2]]s, [[Molten Boss]] and [[Gold Titan]] to spawn their respective enemies.
**[[Gravekeeper]]s can also cause a hindrance when they spawn [[Tombstone]]s at the start of the map.
**For this reason, [[Ranger|Outlaws]] and [[Sniper]]s are recommended as cliffs span the length of the map.
*The [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' does not work when enemies are on the bridge.
*Due to the length of the map, if enemies get past your main defense, you may be in trouble, especially if the enemies include those that spawn other enemies, like the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]], or the [[Necromancer 2]].
**For this reason, the [[Military Base]] is heavily recommended.
